claude.project_scope_control: project install scope and local /skills discovery

standards: Normal host permissions retained; actual source and cache placed inside disposable working root, no added read/write roots or personal config/credential copy.
Actual source and independent cache both immutable across parent observations, approved project host settings and actual check configuration protected.
Read-only preflight and preparation stop before native model client creation; real authorization and exact reviewed digest required before dispatch.
Existing immediate permission/quota/native-error transport stop remains; no nested agents or automatic model/account retry.
spec: Nine ordered fresh cases cover actual required init, code/source experience, cross-owner candidates and specific decisions, actual same-file delivery/closure, exact external adoption, archived A successor B and verify-only drift.
Independent tests and historical run/VER/artifact/event/evidence bytes stay intact; actual owner applications, rule binding and previous decisions required.
A and B are explicitly different sequential label contracts; parent executes both actual literals and distinguishes historical from current validity.
Positive retained source-runtime walkthrough and adversarial parent tests do not substitute for native semantic/authorization trace review.

reproduced_and_fixed.reason: Whole complex verification selected no specific Task, while reused fixture helper still required a default Task identity. Retain a real default Task only for helper version lookup, preserving actual whole-revision and all-Task bindings.

Initial parent protected the independent cache only. Claude can load its registered local installation root in place. Final parent protects both actual roots, adds a separate source-mutation rejection, and final frozen scopes/host preparation replace initial ones before any model call.

limitations: No Codex or Claude model request sent; nine-session native acceptance and its trace audit remain not_run.

Local Claude /skills preparation UI displays its existing default MiniMax-M2.7; no model request was made. Actual dispatch explicitly uses process-only --model MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, without changing the default.
Resource placement removes the known outside-working-root location, but does not prove native model command behavior or semantic completion.
